text:
alex: Heads up — the Python quickstart is failing for me after a fresh pip install. The example repo pins requests==2.28.0 in requirements.txt and on mac (arm64) I get ModuleNotFoundError for 'packaging.version'. Also the Jupyter notebook link in the quickstart 404s: https://docs.redwood.ai/quickstart/python-notebook

alex: Repro steps:
```
python3 -m venv venv
source venv/bin/activate
pip install -r requirements.txt
python -c "import requests; print(requests.__version__)"
# -> Traceback (most recent call last):
# ModuleNotFoundError: No module named 'packaging.version'
```

sam: Did you try pip install --upgrade pip? sometimes older pip/resolver pulls broken wheels.

maria: We used a pip-tools generated constraints.txt last year. Pinning exact requests caused dependency on an older setuptools/packaging on some platforms. Recommend constraints + ranges instead of exact equality.

yusuf: Agree. Proposed change: requirements.txt -> requests>=2.28,<3.0 and add constraints.txt for other transitive pins.

docops: Thanks @alex for reporting — opened DOCS-456 to fix the quickstart snippet and the dead notebook link. I'll push a small docs PR today. :white_check_mark:

devex-bot: Deploy preview for docs PR: https://deploy.previews.redwood.ai/1234 — check the updated requirements and notebook link.

alex: Quick question — any workaround in the meantime? I can't get the sample app to run for onboarding session.

maria: Workaround: pip install packaging setuptools wheel && pip install -r requirements.txt

docops: PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/789 — updated the requirements to ranges and replaced notebook link with stable path https://docs.redwood.ai/quickstart/python-notebook-v2

alex: Tested PR tip — packaging install workaround fixed it. Verified preview link works. Thanks everyone :tada:
